entry.verified: tar.xz: SHA-256 matches Opera's .sha256sum; codesign --verify --deep --strict ok, Developer ID Application: Opera Software AS (A2P9LX4JPN), notarized (spctl)
entry.smoke: fail: Opera 135 crashes at startup here (segfault/bus error within seconds, 4 restarts, with --headless=new, --headless, --disable-gpu, --single-process alike) while Chrome's headless runs; most likely it needs a logged-in GUI session, which this Mac doesn't have (/dev/console owned by root)
entry.notes: Opera.app unpacked to ~/ibbrowsers/opera-135 (tar, no quarantine). Driven over the DevTools protocol: Opera's operadriver for macOS is x86-64 only and this Mac has no Rosetta. Opera's own updater may update it in place.
